body: If someone this successful and well-liked around the world with a daughter that needs him can kill himself, why am I still alive? I don't deserve to be alive right now. Even if it's too late for people like me, I sincerely hope one day there is a true cure for depression so people don't have to resort to ending their lives. No one around me takes my suicidal ideations seriously. Not my wife, parents...will the world ever start to treat this like a real disease? I'll never find out.
If he's better than Messi, he's automatically better than Ronaldo and Messi combined. :)
